theorem lg_target {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Set Ω) : μ s ≤ 1 := by
  have h_total : μ Set.univ = 1 := by simp [MeasureTheory.is_probability_measure_total_measure]
  have h_subset : s ⊆ Set.univ := by simp
  exact MeasureTheory.le_coe_of_subset h_subset h_total
